accepted_at: Database column on pending_invites, set server-side when an invite is claimed. Read from rows in inbox.js and TeamManagement.jsx; nothing in src/ writes it, and nothing should. A true false positive.
readAsDataURL: Not an app data field -- a method on the browser's built-in FileReader, called in src/ShareButton.jsx to convert a rendered share card into base64 for Capacitor's Filesystem plugin. Nothing 'writes' it because there is nothing to write; it ships with every browser.
mine_to_answer: Computed column returned by the my_team_requests() database function (20260925140000_team_joining.sql): true when the open team request or invite is this bowler's to answer. Read in src/TeamManagement.jsx and src/domain/inbox.js; the database computes it, so nothing in src/ writes it. A true false positive.
needs_confirm: Computed column returned by the join_team_with_code() database function (20260925160000_league_edits.sql): true when joining would take the bowler off another team in the same league, so the app asks before calling again with p_confirm. Read in src/TeamManagement.jsx; nothing in src/ writes it. A true false positive.
addedNodes: Not an app data field -- properties of the browser's MutationRecord, read in src/i18n/dom.js where the page translator watches React's changes to the page.
attributeName: Not an app data field -- properties of the browser's MutationRecord, read in src/i18n/dom.js where the page translator watches React's changes to the page.
removedNodes: Not an app data field -- properties of the browser's MutationRecord, read in src/i18n/dom.js where the page translator watches React's changes to the page.
